evidence.reason: The finding alleged that the wire built at submit.ts:158 omitted `i.task`, `i.branch`, `i.predecessor`, and `i.observed` even though `SubmitInputSchema`/`WireSchema` support them. In the supplied current source, the `WireSchema.parse({...})` construction (now at lines 179-191) explicitly conditionally spreads all four fields: `task` (187), `branch` (188), `predecessor` (189), and `observed` (190). Those values are thus included in the wire and in the persisted record/`client.request(wire)`, so the described silent-discard behavior no longer exists. The history shows the metadata/continuity work landed in 04a5c71b ("classify history and predecessor continuity"), which matches the forwarding of predecessor/history metadata; the finding is therefore already fixed at the current tip.
